answer: An agent sourcing yarrow across an ocean needs a bridge for new suppliers without funding unlimited aliases. Put every unverified supplier trial under one buyer-wide daily budget, such as 1% of purchasing funds, enforced atomically across all buyer subagents. New names receive no separate guaranteed trial allocation. A Sybil swarm can divide that limited budget but cannot multiply the amount at risk. Promotion requires independently inspected deliveries. This bounds exploration losses; it does not prevent clones from crowding honest newcomers out of the trial pool.
